purpose: Structured suggestion backlog for small, contributor-friendly improvements to the Graft CLI project.

suggestions.title: Choose and add a project license
suggestions.rationale: The repository currently has no explicit reuse permissions, so contributors and users need a clear license before public distribution or packaging.
acceptance_criteria: Add a LICENSE file at the repository root.
Update README.md so it no longer says license permissions are undecided.
Confirm the chosen license matches the maintainer's intended reuse posture.

suggestions.title: Add example workflows and CLI usage docs
suggestions.rationale: Concrete examples make the CLI easier to understand and give new contributors safe documentation work to start with.
acceptance_criteria: Add docs/examples.md or an equivalent examples document.
Document at least three copy-pasteable commands.
Include examples for scanning a repository, scanning a subfolder, and using check mode.

suggestions.title: Implement optional dry-run mode for CLI
suggestions.rationale: A dry-run mode would let users preview manifest and Markdown inventory changes without touching files.
acceptance_criteria: Print which files would be created or updated.
Do not modify files while dry-run mode is active.
Add tests that prove files are left unchanged.

suggestions.title: Decide whether generated manifest.json should be tracked
suggestions.rationale: Generated manifests are useful examples, but tracking them by default can create noisy diffs in real projects.
acceptance_criteria: Record the tracking policy in documentation.
Keep manifest.json ignored unless a tracked example is intentionally added.
Update README.md or docs/examples.md with the chosen guidance.

maintenance_notes: Keep this file hand-editable and dependency-free.
When an issue closes, update the matching suggestion status.
Prefer small suggestions that are easy for contributors to understand and verify.
